c139202821.notes: Weathered plank on two wooden posts at the entrance of the Villa Los Setenta neighbourhood, El Quisco (camera -33.3994, -71.6861); hand-painted white stencil-style letters with black shadow, seen from below at dusk. Back of an octagonal stop sign at right is a distractor.

c139206529.notes: Wavy-edged wooden board with burnt/painted black letters on two posts, on the Costanera of El Quisco (camera -33.3951, -71.6979). 'Fco.' abbreviates Francisco; there is almost no space after 'Fco.' and only a narrow gap between Ceballos and Seco.

c139206533.notes: Municipal beach board in El Quisco (camera -33.3981, -71.7005), angled view; the beach name is the large heading. Only the heading and the two warning lines under it are transcribed. The rest of the board is a list of rules (PROHIBIDO EL TRÁNSITO DE VEHÍCULOS EN LA PLAYA, ...), emergency numbers (TELÉFONOS DE EMERGENCIA, 131 ATENCIÓN MÉDICA URGENCIA, ...), a Municipalidad de El Quisco crest and a red bottom band 'NO APTA PARA EL BAÑO'. Two vertical shadow stripes from the posts cross the board.
